answer.why: D.R. Horton is "America's Largest Home Builder" that builds and sells new homes to individual buyers across the US, with ancillary mortgage, title, and insurance services [T:P1.1, T:P2.3, T:P3.3]. KB Home likewise builds and sells new homes ("Find new homes for sale") to individual buyers in AZ, CA, CO, FL, ID, NV, NC, SC, TX, WA, with design studios and ancillary mortgage/title services [C:P1.1, C:P1.2, C:P1.4]. Both are OEM homebuilders whose primary product is newly constructed residential homes sold directly to individual homebuyers — same product, same customers. The only material difference is that D.R. Horton has a larger geographic footprint and an explicit rental-community segment [T:P2.4], while KB Home appears more regionally concentrated; but the core homebuilding business is identical in model, product, and buyer.

T:P1.1.text: D.R. Horton America's Largest Home Builder | Homes For Sale

T:P1.2.text: Explore new homes for sale by D.R. Horton-America's Builder. Browse featured communities and discover move-in ready homes near you.

T:P1.3.text: Better pricing. Extra perks. More ways to save.

T:P1.4.text: The Red Tag Event brings big savings for a limited time. See what's available near you.

T:P1.5.text: Check out what's behind the door of America's Smart Home.

T:P1.6.text: We want to work with you to find your clients' new homes.

T:P1.7.text: We're proud to build homes for those who serve.

T:P1.8.text: We all love to see our homebuyers' smiling faces.

T:P2.3.text: From our first home to over 1,000,000 homes our mission remains the same — to deliver quality and affordability across the country.

T:P2.4.text: more people have chosen D.R. Horton than any other builder. Buy or rent, we have homes and services to provide a home for every stage in life.

T:P2.5.text: I'm officially a new homeowner & Koda is excited for his new backyard!

T:P2.6.text: Our home buying process was outstanding. From the realtor showing us our soon-to-be home for the very first time, to the final walkthrough with the superintendent, we were amazed!

T:P2.8.text: One week as a homeowner and I’m still clapping for myself. This was one of my hardest goals to achieve. Here I am, 41, and a first-time homeowner.

T:P2.9.text: As first-time homebuyers, we had some nerves while starting the home-buying process but quickly felt at ease by everyone from the D.R. Horton team and our realtor.

T:P2.11.text: Our sales agent Paul went above and beyond to ensure we were taken care of. Our building superintendent, Glenn was also fantastic. We love D.R. Horton!!

T:P2.14.text: We're more than just your homebuilder.

T:P2.15.text: Get a seamless experience with your financial goals in mind.

T:P2.16.text: When it's all said and done, you can take care of your title.

T:P2.17.text: After you buy, we have options to protect your home and possessions.

T:P2.18.text: When you have good people, good things happen.

T:P3.2.text: We keep home in the family.

T:P3.4.text: It's more than financing, it's about people.

T:P3.5.text: We're here to provide a seamless experience with your financial goals in mind.

T:P3.6.text: When it's yours, we've got you covered.

T:P3.7.text: When it’s all said and done, we can assist with title coverage.

T:P3.8.text: We'll help you keep your peace of mind.

C:P1.1.text: New Home Builders In Your Area - KB Home

C:P1.2.text: KB Home builds homes for the way you live. Find new homes for sale with open floor plans, energy-efficient features and personalize to fit your style.

C:P1.3.text: We build homes for all of life’s small but epic moments. That’s why we put our experience in the service of your dreams and partner with you to design a new home that reflects your style and budget. We devote our attention to you. We listen to you. And we do all of that before we even break ground. Because we see you.

C:P1.6.text: You have a dream. We help you build it.

C:P1.7.text: Designing your dream home starts here.

C:P1.8.text: When it comes to turning your vision into a reality, the KB Design Studio is where the magic happens.

C:P1.9.text: Enjoy the convenience and security of smart tech.

C:P1.10.text: We offer lots of great ways to make daily life easier, thanks to smart home devices and appliances, like thermostats, wall switches, and garage door openers.

C:P1.11.text: Greater comfort, well-being and savings come standard.

C:P1.12.text: Home should be the best place of all, so ours are built to boost energy and water efficiency, lower utility costs and conserve natural resources. We also include quality materials and features for healthier indoor environments.

C:P1.13.text: Built to fit your life and budget.

C:P1.14.text: When you build a new home with us, you enjoy complete control and only pay for the things that matter most.

C:P1.15.text: Feel good about the company you keep.

C:P1.16.text: We believe in getting involved and contributing to the neighborhoods where we build to help support local residents. Making a difference for the greater good is something we can all feel good about.

C:P1.17.text: The sales staff was helpful and responsive, and our construction superintendent took us through the home in detail and has been available for questions even after buying our home. They follow up with us on a monthly basis to make sure that all is well. We love our KB home and the entire experience of purchasing our home.

C:P1.19.text: I didn't know what to expect when buying from KB. The process was smooth, and the staff was communicative. The web portal with all the information was great, and then after closing, all of your documents are there to view.
